title: regional-sku-consolidation-proposal
summary: Draft sheet exploring consolidation of hosted API SKUs across regions to improve unit economics by reducing SKU fragmentation and simplifying routing. Proposes candidate SKU mappings, sensitivity table, and operational tradeoffs.
content:
Purpose:
- Reduce marginal COGS and operational complexity by consolidating low-volume regional SKUs into 3 canonical SKU families per model family.
- Target outcome: improve blended gross margin by 2-5 percentage points for long-tail regions while keeping latency SLOs acceptable.

High-level approach:
1) Identify long-tail region-model pairs with <0.5% of global token volume but >2x PPK variance vs global median.
2) Evaluate consolidation strategies: global fallback routing, soft-fallback to quantized variant, reserve spot-to-dedicated routing.
3) Run sensitivity on price elasticity (0%, -10%, +10% per-token demand) and latency degradation tolerance (+20ms, +50ms).

Key assumptions (editable cells):
- GPU amortized rate by region: us-west=0.28 $/hour, eu-west=0.32 $/hour, ap-south=0.35 $/hour
- Average tokens per request (A): 120
- Median batch efficiency multiplier (B): 0.85
- Target margin floor: 30%

Example consolidated SKU mapping (sample rows from sheet):
Model Family | Region | Current PPK $ | After consolidate PPK $ | Est. Latency delta ms | Routing rec
mantic-13B   | AP-South | 0.0125     | 0.0090                 | +28                   | fallback-quantized
mantic-13B   | EU-North | 0.0108     | 0.0095                 | +12                   | route-eu-west
mantic-70B   | AP-South | 0.0450     | 0.0350                 | +40                   | dedicated-reserve
openchat-15B  | SA-East  | 0.0200     | 0.0130                 | +35                   | global-fallback
openchat-15B  | US-Central|0.0112     | 0.0098                 | +8                    | route-us-west

Blended impact snapshot (sample calc):
- Baseline weighted avg PPK across long-tail: 0.0182 $
- Post-consolidation weighted avg PPK: 0.0134 $
- Absolute per-token savings: 0.0048 $
- With current monthly long-tail token volume = 450M tokens => monthly savings = 2.16k $
- Estimated gross margin lift (company-wide blended, conservative) = +1.9% ; optimistic = +4.3%

Sensitivity table (selected cells):
Scenario | Demand change | Latency tolerance | Blended PPK | Monthly savings
Base     | 0%            | +20ms            | 0.0134      | $2,160
Low demand| -10%         | +20ms            | 0.0138      | $1,740
High demand| +10%         | +50ms            | 0.0129      | $2,640

Operational tradeoffs and risks:
- Complexity: fewer SKUs reduces routing table size but increases risk of localized hotspots; require rate limiting by region after consolidation.
- SLO risk: some requests will see higher tail latency; propose canary and synthetic monitors in next 4 weeks.
- Billing/Customer experience: enterprise customers in regulated regions may require explicit opt-ins before fallback.

Open questions and TODOs:
- Get actual per-model per-region GPU utilization heatmap from infra (owner: Ethan) by 2025-03-05.
- Validate amortized GPU $/hour inputs with Finance (owner: Marta) and include license costs.
- Quick A/B plan: run 1-week trial routing 5% of long-tail traffic to consolidated SKUs and measure delta on p95 latency and ppk.

Next steps:
- Convert this draft into a runnable sheet with pivoted model x region tabs and scenario toggles (owner: Priya)
- Prep canary rollout playbook and runbook for rollback thresholds (owner: Jun)
- Present to Optimize leadership on 2025-03-08 with initial infra metrics

Notes and references:
- See linked artifacts for simulation notebook and prior sensitivity runs
- Slack threads: #optimize-ppk (refs: thread ts 1678429), #infra-costs

Rough cell formulas (human readable):
- blended_ppk = sum(region_volume_i * ppk_i) / sum(region_volume_i)
- est_savings = (baseline_ppk - post_ppk) * long_tail_tokens
- margin_lift_pct = est_savings / baseline_revenue
